unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 "A Nano (XNO) offer for the buyer who pays for the API, not for the shield — settle per call, no deposit and no voucher" on nicolasholman/kage-zcash, verified OPEN. Honest boundary first: Nano is public, not a Zcash privacy replacement. Argued the complementary class: x402 is asset-agnostic, many purchases need no shield; XNO settles per call with no shielded deposit and no cumulative voucher, spend policy enforced on the payment itself, seller verifies by reading the public block not a viewing key. Carry: github.com/dhyabi2/nano-invoice. URL: https://github.com/nicolasholman/ka
